name: Ideate product-idea quality
prompt: Given an operator's business context, produce docs/product-idea.md with three to five distinct candidates, each scored on all five axes with a one-line justification, a selected direction whose rationale traces to its scores, and no fabricated market numbers. Preserve the Candidates section once written.
expected_output: A product-idea.md with a Candidates section holding three to five scored candidates and a Selected direction that references the winner's axis scores. No market-size or revenue figure is stated as fact without a source.

assertions.text: Three to five distinct candidate directions are present under Candidates.
A Candidates section is present and intact.
Every candidate is scored on Pain, Reach, Willingness to pay, Founder edge, and Feasibility, each with a one-line justification.
The Selected direction rationale references the winner's axis scores.
No market-size or revenue number is stated as fact without a source.
